-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks (TASK_NAME,DATA_LAYER,SCHEMA_NAME,TABLE_NAME,SOURCE_CODE,DESCRIPTION,UPDATE_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,MONTHEND,FREQUENCY_LOADING,TABLE_TYPE)
SELECT 'TSK_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE','EDS','EDS','GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE','GLD',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2';GO

--GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks (TASK_NAME,DATA_LAYER,SCHEMA_NAME,TABLE_NAME,SOURCE_CODE,DESCRIPTION,UPDATE_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,MONTHEND,FREQUENCY_LOADING,TABLE_TYPE)
SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE','EDS_STG','D360','STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE','GLD',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2';GO

-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency (DEPENDENCY_ID,TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MONTHEND)
SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE','TSK_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE',NULL; GO
